group.passage:
Walruses and manatees are two large, gray, water-dwelling creatures. At first glance, they have a lot in common. Yet, they are not actually that much alike.
Walruses are bigger than manatees. The average manatee will weigh around 1,200 pounds, while walruses can weigh up to 3,700 pounds. The walrus is shorter than the manatee, but it has a lot more muscle and fat compared to the manatee.
Walruses live in some of the coldest places on the planet, whereas manatees tend to live in warm areas of the world. For example, walruses live on ice floes and on remote coastlines around the Arctic Circle and the sub-Arctic areas such as the U.S., Canada, Russia, and Greenland. They only live in saltwater areas of the world, though. Manatees live in both saltwater and freshwater areas, and they are also found in brackish environments. That means they are at home in rivers, ocean bays, and other such areas. However, one species of the manatee, known as the Amazonian Manatee, solely lives in the fresh water of the Amazon River.
Manatees are herbivores, thriving on sea grass, weeds, algae, and other plant life on the bottom of the sea. In contrast, walruses are entirely carnivores, feeding on a wide variety of foods, including shellfish, snails, fish, squid, and the occasional seal.
Manatees have about six teeth tucked away into their cheeks for eating, but walruses have 18 teeth, including the massive tusks for which they are well-known. The two most prominent teeth of walruses, their tusks, are massive canine teeth that grow up to 30 inches in length. These teeth have many uses for a walrus. They can be used to drag through the bottom sediments in water to find shellfish, to fend off predators or to attack large prey, like seals. To sum up, walruses’ teeth are more numerous and useful than those of manatees.
In conclusion, walruses and manatees do have some similarities, but their difference far outweighs their shared traits.

figures.description: 黑白世界地圖（橢圓形投影），上方標經度 180°W、140°W、100°W、60°W、20°W、0°、20°E、60°E、100°E、140°E、180°E，左側標緯度 80°N、60°N、40°N、20°N、0°、20°S、40°S、60°S、80°S。圖上標有大洲名 NOUTH AMERICA（原圖如此拼寫，指北美洲）、SOUTH AMERICA、EUROPE、AFRICA、ASIA、AUSTRALIA、ANTARCTICA，以及海洋名 Pacific Ocean（左右各一）、Atlantic Ocean、Indian Ocean。地圖上有四個圓圈標記：A 在北美洲北部、加拿大北部（約 60°N 附近的寒冷地區）；B 在北美洲南端的墨西哥灣／加勒比海一帶（約 20°N，美國佛羅里達與墨西哥之間的溫暖海域）；C 在亞洲北部內陸、俄羅斯西伯利亞一帶（約 50°N–60°N、100°E 附近，遠離海洋）；D 在南極洲沿岸（約 60°S–70°S）。

figures.label: 第4題選項(A)–(D)的範本圖
figures.description: 第4題四個選項各附一張範本圖：(A) A SWOT analysis.——上方標題框「Walruses vs. Manatees」，下面四條向右的箭頭色帶，依序標 Strengths、Weaknesses、Opportunities、Threats；(B) A life cycle chart.——上方標題框「Life Cycle of Walruses and Manatees」，下面五個方塊以順時針箭頭繞成一圈：Birth → Nursing → Adulthood → Mating → Old Age →（回到 Birth）；(C) A pyramid chart.——一個三角形金字塔，旁邊三個標籤由上到下依序為 Manatees、Walruses、Others；(D) A Venn Diagram.——兩個部分重疊的圓，左圓標 Manatees、右圓標 Walruses，中間為重疊區。

questions.stem:
In what order does the author compare walruses and manatees in this passage?
a. diet b. habitat c. dental structure d. size
According to the passage, where can manatees be found?
According to the passage, which of the following statements about walruses or manatees is true?

options.A: Manatees have massive canine teeth as long as 30 inches.
options.B: Walruses can be over three times heavier than manatees.
options.C: Manatees can live in all types of water areas regardless of their species.
options.D: Walruses are strong predators despite having less muscle than manatees.
